visualCharacteristics.layout: 5-up row of light image-led tiles on desktop; horizontal scroll-snap slider on small screens
visualCharacteristics.imageTreatment: 16:9 photo on top of each tile
visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: white background, dark text, blue text link
visualCharacteristics.purpose: teaser tiles linking to sub-pages (e.g. Aerospace Submarkets)

optionLayouts.grid: wrapping grid, 4 per row from 900px, 2 from 600px, 1 below; bordered tiles with padded text; 16:9 image on top
optionLayouts.text: text-only bordered white cards: centred title + short description, whole card clickable; up to 4 per row (2 from 600px, 1 below), short rows centred; a lone card is wider/taller; external links show a small external-link icon top right. Combines with grid.
optionLayouts.buttons: used with text ('text, buttons'): white cards with a soft box-shadow instead of a border, centred title and description, CTA rendered as a full-width gold pill button aligned at the bottom of each card; the card is NOT one big link; 3 per row from 900px (2 from 600px, 1 below)

contentPattern.structure: [picture] | [H3 title, short description paragraph, 'Learn More' link]
contentPattern.summary: repeating teaser cards: image, H3, description, Learn More link

optionStructures.text: one cell per row: [H3 > link title, short description paragraph] (no picture cell)
optionStructures.buttons: one cell per row: [H3 title (unlinked), short description paragraph, paragraph containing only the CTA link]
